evals.name: explicit-takeover-produces-traceable-assets
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo in takeover mode to understand the current large repository. Persist the result under .edru and do not modify product code.
evals.expected_output: The agent freezes the repository baseline, reconstructs topology and representative critical paths from evidence, writes only derived .edru assets, validates their structure, and reports unresolved unknowns.
expectations: Records revision, branch, dirty state, scope, build/runtime context, permissions, and budget before drawing repository-wide conclusions.
Derives boundaries from build, deployment, registration, contracts, and implementation evidence rather than directory names alone.
Keeps source, configuration, data, and remote resources read-only while writing only the requested .edru deliverables.
Runs the asset validator and distinguishes structural validation from truth validation.
Links the final four answers to claims, evidence, or explicit unknowns.

evals.name: ordinary-debugging-does-not-trigger-takeover
evals.prompt: A unit test in parser_test.py fails after yesterday's change. Diagnose the first causal error in the parser implementation.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not invoke EDRU solely because debugging requires reading repository files; it uses an appropriate focused debugging workflow.
expectations: Does not create a .edru directory or require a full repository takeover.
Does not force survey, takeover, or change-ready assets into a focused debugging request.
Recognizes that ordinary implementation, debugging, review, and single-file questions are outside automatic EDRU routing.

evals.name: change-ready-requires-target
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo in change-ready mode on this repository, but I have not decided what will change.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks one focused question for the change target before producing target-level impact analysis, while avoiding invented consumers or a fabricated impact matrix.
expectations: Treats the missing change target as material to the requested deliverable.
Asks only for the target or intended change needed to define the impact closure.
Does not claim target-level readiness, safe modification, or complete impact analysis without a target.

evals.name: no-runtime-access-preserves-static-progress
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo to survey this repository. You may read files but may not run builds, tests, services, or network requests.
evals.expected_output: The agent completes the supportable static survey, labels relationships DECLARED or MAY as appropriate, records dynamic gaps, and avoids claiming C4 evidence.
expectations: Does not run unauthorized commands that execute repository code or access the network.
Does not relabel static reachability as OBSERVED or C4.
Uses completed_with_unknowns when the survey objective is answered despite dynamic evidence gaps, rather than treating all missing runtime access as blocked.
Records concrete next actions for material dynamic unknowns.

evals.name: budgeted-survey-does-not-fake-completeness
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo in survey mode for this monorepo. Limit the work to 30 minutes and two executable units.
evals.expected_output: The agent fixes the included scope and denominators up front, prioritizes high-value evidence, stops at the budget, and reports explicit exclusions and unknowns without implying whole-repository coverage.
expectations: Defines the two included executable units and records the rest as excluded or unknown before reporting coverage.
Does not use file counts, asset counts, or an undefined denominator as proof of completion.
Stops when the budget is reached and reports a truthful status and continuation actions.
Scopes every conclusion to the inspected revision and included units.

evals.name: high-risk-unknown-blocks-safe-change-claim
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo in change-ready mode for renaming the public OrderCreated event. An external consumer registry is inaccessible.
evals.expected_output: The agent maps known producers and consumers, records the inaccessible external consumer set as a high-severity unknown, prepares validation and rollback plans, and does not claim the rename is safe.
expectations: Checks build dependencies, symbol references, event schema, registrations, tests, deployment, history, and known consumers within scope.
Treats inaccessible external consumers as unknown rather than as evidence of no consumers.
Allows the analysis itself to complete with unknowns while making the safe-to-modify gate fail.
Provides a concrete next validation action and rollback condition.

evals.name: incremental-update-invalidates-only-bounded-closure
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo with operation update and mode takeover. Refresh the existing .edru assets from revision abc123 to def456 after a localized parser refactor, preserving still-valid knowledge.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates the parent manifest, preserves affected parent assets in history, computes a bounded invalidation closure, retains still-applicable records with lineage, regenerates impacted assets, and emits an update summary.
expectations: Treats update and takeover as separate dimensions rather than inventing an update mode.
Compares revision and execution-envelope dimensions before reusing prior claims or evidence.
Preserves the parent manifest and changed assets before overwriting them.
Records retained, invalidated, superseded, and regenerated items without deleting stale provenance.
Runs the validator with --operation update --mode takeover and separates structural success from truth validation.

evals.name: update-without-valid-baseline-does-not-invent-lineage
evals.prompt: Update the existing .edru knowledge, but its manifest.yaml is missing and no previous run ID or revision can be recovered.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not silently overwrite the assets or fabricate a parent run. It asks whether to repair the baseline or execute a new create operation.
expectations: Treats a readable, sufficiently identified parent manifest as a prerequisite for update.
Does not infer old revision, run ID, or evidence applicability from filenames or current HEAD.
Does not relabel the request as a successful update without user direction.
Preserves existing files while the lifecycle decision is unresolved.

evals.name: major-refactor-forces-full-rebaseline-with-lineage
evals.prompt: Update the takeover assets after the repository replaced its root build system, moved most modules, and rewrote public schemas. The previous manifest is valid.
evals.expected_output: The agent records operation update with strategy full_rebaseline, preserves parent history, rebuilds the selected mode from the target snapshot, and explains why incremental reuse is unsafe.
expectations: Does not reuse stale locators or confidence merely to minimize work.
Keeps the parent run and from/to snapshot lineage even though analysis is rebuilt.
Records a non-empty fallback reason and the evidence supporting the strategy decision.
Does not misrepresent full_rebaseline as a fresh create operation.

evals.name: update-change-ready-refreshes-before-impact-closure
evals.prompt: Use $understand-repo operation update with mode change-ready for changing the PaymentAuthorized message. Refresh the old .edru baseline first.
evals.expected_output: The agent refreshes affected baseline knowledge from the parent snapshot and then performs target-specific impact closure; stale parent coverage cannot satisfy the safe-to-modify gate.
expectations: Requires both a valid update baseline and an explicit change target.
Refreshes affected topology, contracts, state consumers, and critical paths before judging change impact.
Produces both 13-change-impact-matrix.md and 16-update-summary.md.
Blocks a safe-to-modify conclusion when high-severity consumers remain unbounded.
